description: Versioned DynamoDB persistence (design sec.9) + resolution flow + variable-validated rendering, WITHOUT breaking the existing SMS/EMAIL/PUSH/WHATSAPP send path over RabbitMQ or OTP resolution. Rewrite DynamoDbTemplateAdapter to the PK id=CODE#TIPO#LANG + SK sk schema (v#<n> immutable versions + v#ACTIVE denormalized pointer), add a DynamoDB entity + mapper, implement create/edit via TransactWriteItems, rollback, history Query, and expose resolve-active + admin repo operations through ports. Integrate TemplateType into NotificationTemplateFactory/resolution so {{var}} render keeps working per type and declared variables are validated against params. Depends on FEAT-001 (new model, enums, port packages).
steps: Extend application/port/out/persistence/TemplateRepositoryPort with the operations the resolver and admin need: Optional<NotificationTemplate> findActive(String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language); void createNewVersion(NotificationTemplate tpl) (writes next v#<n> + updates v#ACTIVE in ONE transaction); void activateVersion(String id, int version) (rollback/activate pointer); List<NotificationTemplate> findHistory(String id); List<NotificationTemplate> findByTipo(TemplateType tipo); void deactivate(String id). Keep a backward-compatible resolve overload used by the send path.

Create infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence/entity/NotificationTemplateItem.java representing the raw DynamoDB item attributes (id, sk, codigo, tipo, language, body_template, variables L<S>, version N, is_active BOOL, audiencia M, subject, content_type, wa_template_name, rabbit_exchange, rabbit_routing_key, rabbit_queue, event_type, title, routing M, categoria, pantalla_destino, titulo, cta_label, cta_action, cerrable, prioridad, vigencia_desde, vigencia_hasta, condicion_aparicion, tiempo_desaparicion, created_at/by, updated_at/by).

Create infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence/mapper/NotificationTemplateItemMapper.java: toDomain(Map<String,AttributeValue>) -> NotificationTemplate and toItem(NotificationTemplate) -> Map<String,AttributeValue>, mapping Audience/AlertMeta/NotificationRouting to/from DynamoDB M and L<S> attributes. This mapper is the ONLY code that knows attribute names.

Rewrite infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence/adapter/DynamoDbTemplateAdapter.java (relocated in FEAT-001): resolve for send = GetItem(PK=id, SK='v#ACTIVE') then mapper.toDomain; build id as CODE#TIPO#LANG. createNewVersion: read current v#ACTIVE to get activeVersion (0 if none), compute n+1, build the immutable v#<n+1> item AND the v#ACTIVE pointer item (denormalized copy with activeVersion=n+1), write BOTH via TransactWriteItems (software.amazon.awssdk.services.dynamodb.model.TransactWriteItemsRequest with two Put). activateVersion: read v#<version>, overwrite v#ACTIVE pointer with its content (TransactWriteItems or PutItem). findHistory: Query(PK=id, sk begins_with 'v#') excluding/including v#ACTIVE as documented. findByTipo: Query GSI_tipo. deactivate: update v#ACTIVE is_active=false. Catch AWS exceptions and translate to InvalidTemplate/empty as the current adapter does. The application/domain layer must stay free of any DynamoDB import.

Add application/util for rendering + validation: a TemplateRenderer (move the {{var}} String.replace logic out of TemplateServiceImpl.render) and a VariableValidator that checks every declared template.variables key is present in params before render, throwing InvalidTemplateException (or logging + failing the NotificationResult) when a required var is missing.

Update application/service: define application/port/in/ResolveTemplateUseCase (resolveActive(codigo, tipo, language) -> NotificationTemplate for the send hot path) and keep TemplateService's render; implement in application/service/impl/TemplateServiceImpl using the new findActive port and the renderer/validator. Preserve the @Cacheable behavior and the language fallback to 'es'. Ensure the cache key reflects codigo#tipo#language.

Integrate TemplateType into application/template/NotificationTemplateFactory and AbstractNotificationTemplate.buildBody/buildSubject so resolution uses tipo (mapping legacy channel name -> TemplateType: PUSH->NOTIFICACION send still works, EMAIL/SMS/WHATSAPP map 1:1) and still resolves the v#ACTIVE template. The 4 @RabbitListener consumers and senders must keep working unchanged. OTP templates (VERIFICACION_OTP#SMS#es, VERIFICACION_EMAIL#EMAIL#es) must resolve via the new path.

Add unit tests under src/test/java/.../infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence (mapper round-trip: toItem->toDomain preserves per-type fields for each of the 6 types) and src/test/java/.../application/util (VariableValidator passes when all vars present, fails when missing; renderer replaces {{var}}). Mock DynamoDbClient for any adapter-level test of transaction assembly (verify TransactWriteItems contains v#<n+1> and v#ACTIVE).
Run '.\gradlew.bat build' and fix until BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
acceptance_criteria: DynamoDbTemplateAdapter resolves send templates via GetItem on SK='v#ACTIVE' and builds PK as CODE#TIPO#LANG.

createNewVersion writes the immutable v#<n+1> item and updates the v#ACTIVE pointer atomically via TransactWriteItems; activateVersion repoints v#ACTIVE to a prior version (rollback); findHistory queries begins_with 'v#'.
No class under application/ or domain/ imports software.amazon.awssdk (DynamoDB stays in infrastructure).

Rendering validates declared variables against params and renders {{var}} correctly; a missing required variable surfaces as InvalidTemplateException / failed NotificationResult rather than a silent blank.
The 4 RabbitMQ consumers (push/email/sms/whatsapp) still process a NotificationMessage end-to-end resolving the active version, and OTP templates resolve.
'.\gradlew.bat build' prints BUILD SUCCESSFUL with the new mapper/validator/renderer unit tests passing.

findings:
BUILD SUCCESSFUL (FinancialEventRouterTest + new mapper/util/adapter tests pass). Base package com.findu.notification.processor.

PORT application.port.out.persistence.TemplateRepositoryPort now exposes: Optional<NotificationTemplate> findActive(String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language); void createNewVersion(NotificationTemplate tpl); void activateVersion(String id, int version); List<NotificationTemplate> findHistory(String id); List<NotificationTemplate> findByTipo(TemplateType tipo); void deactivate(String id); plus legacy Optional<NotificationTemplate> findByCodeAndChannelAndLanguage(code,channel,lang) and findByCodeAndChannel(code,channel) kept for the send path.

NEW IN-PORT application.port.in.ResolveTemplateUseCase.resolveActive(String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language) -> Optional<NotificationTemplate>; implemented by application.service.impl.TemplateServiceImpl (which also implements TemplateService). TemplateService gained findTemplate(String code, TemplateType tipo, String language) overload (hot path, @Cacheable key 'code#tipo#language', fallback language 'es') while keeping findTemplate(code, String channel, language). render(template, params) now validates then renders.

UTIL application.util: TemplateRenderer.render(String bodyTemplate, Map<String,String> params) (extracted {{var}} String.replace; null body -> ""); VariableValidator.validate(NotificationTemplate, Map<String,String>) throws domain.exception.InvalidTemplateException listing missing/blank declared variables.

CHANNEL->TIPO mapping: domain.enums.TemplateType.fromChannel(NotificationChannel) -> EMAIL/SMS/WHATSAPP 1:1, PUSH->NOTIFICACION. AbstractNotificationTemplate.resolveTemplate() uses it so the 4 RabbitMQ consumers resolve the v#ACTIVE template by tipo. OTP resolves via VERIFICACION_OTP#SMS#es / VERIFICACION_EMAIL#EMAIL#es.

PERSISTENCE: infrastructure.adapter.out.persistence.entity.NotificationTemplateItem = constants holder of ALL DynamoDB attribute names + helpers buildId(codigo,tipo,language) (CODE#TIPO#LANG, upper/upper/lower), versionSk(n) (v#<n>), SK_ACTIVE='v#ACTIVE', SK_PREFIX='v#'. Attribute names (snake_case): id(PK), sk(SK), codigo, tipo, language, body_template, variables (L<S>), version (N), is_active (BOOL), active_version (N, only on v#ACTIVE pointer), audiencia (M: modo S, filtros M, userIds L<S>), created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, channel (legacy), subject, content_type, wa_template_name, rabbit_exchange, rabbit_routing_key, rabbit_queue, event_type, title, routing (M: condicion, canal_si_activo, canal_si_inactivo), alert_meta (M: categoria, pantalla_destino, titulo, cta_label, cta_action, cerrable BOOL, prioridad N, vigencia_desde, vigencia_hasta, condicion_aparicion, tiempo_desaparicion N).

MAPPER infrastructure.adapter.out.persistence.mapper.NotificationTemplateItemMapper (@Component) is the ONLY attribute-name-aware code: toDomain(Map<String,AttributeValue>) and toItem(NotificationTemplate), mapping Audience/AlertMeta/NotificationRouting to/from M and L<S>.

ADAPTER infrastructure.adapter.out.persistence.adapter.DynamoDbTemplateAdapter (@Component, ctor injects DynamoDbClient + NotificationTemplateItemMapper): findActive=GetItem(id,'v#ACTIVE'); createNewVersion reads v#ACTIVE active_version (0 if none), n+1, writes v#<n+1> immutable + v#ACTIVE pointer (with active_version) via TransactWriteItems (2 Put); activateVersion reads v#<version> and re-points v#ACTIVE (is_active=true) via TransactWriteItems; findHistory=Query begins_with 'v#' excluding v#ACTIVE; findByTipo=Query on GSI index name (config findu.notification.templates.gsi-tipo, default 'GSI_tipo'); deactivate=UpdateItem is_active=false on v#ACTIVE. AWS errors caught -> InvalidTemplateException or empty/List.of(). No application/domain class imports software.amazon.awssdk (verified).

CONFIG properties: findu.notification.templates.table (default notification_templates), findu.notification.templates.gsi-tipo (default GSI_tipo). Cache name 'notification-templates' (CacheConfig) unchanged; key now code#tipo#language.

SEED/ADMIN LAYER NEEDS (FEAT-003/004): write items at SK=v#<n> and SK=v#ACTIVE with the snake_case attribute names above; v#ACTIVE must carry active_version (N) and is_active (BOOL); PK id = CODE#TIPO#LANG (tipo uppercased, language lowercased); OTP seed ids VERIFICACION_OTP#SMS#es and VERIFICACION_EMAIL#EMAIL#es; create GSI named 'GSI_tipo' on attribute 'tipo' for findByTipo. gradle-wrapper.jar present in worktree (git-ignored, NOT committed).

GITIGNORE FIX (root cause for later FEATs): the repo .gitignore line '**/out/' (meant for build output) was collaterally ignoring the hexagonal source packages application/port/out/** and infrastructure/adapter/out/** created in FEAT-001, so FEAT-001's commit silently EXCLUDED all senders, persistence adapters, entity, mapper and out-ports. Added negation '!**/src/**/out/' (mirrors existing '!**/src/**/bin/') so src-tree out/ packages are tracked. This FEAT-002 commit (99b8caf) therefore also adds the previously-untracked FEAT-001 out/ files (4 senders, DynamoDbNotificationStatusAdapter, out-ports). Commit on branch feature/notif-template-engine.
